description: Deletes up to 100 items by slug; slugs not found are listed. Confirm with the user before deleting content they wrote. Writes go to the branch the workspace has open, the same as the Content tab. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. Works on every plan within its collection and item limits (Free: 2 collections and 100 items a site); turning a folder into a Xodia collection needs a paid plan.

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: The collection id (its folder under content/), from list_collections

name: delete_items
title: Delete CMS items
